Cross-family review of the restore (Codex gpt-6.1-sol, read-only), six rounds on 2026-10-03, one on each restore rule the section gave in PRs #97 and #99, traced every one into an entry that takes the wrong entity or gets a second one. #97 round 1, through the fixed code (blob ac8b38ef), R21-01: an entry left in the file by an unregister whose save failed (Save's result ignored, SecretRock_Persistence.c:263) takes the nearest unclaimed rock even though it carries another entry's id, rebinds it and applies its own state (:335-346, :395-421). #97 round 2, R21-03: the same stale entry takes an admin's console rock that carries no id; R21-04: an entry whose id was regenerated after a failed save would get a second rock under a rule that excludes every entity with another id (:547-551, :407-417; MissionServer.c:9-10 schedules the second pass). Round 3 also notes that SecretRock starts no restore pass from EEInit (RestoreAll is called only from SecretRock_MissionServer.c:31), so R21-08 and R21-09 are counterexamples to the rules' text, not failures observed in the mod. All are traces through the code and the rules' text; none was reproduced in game. The section therefore gives no restore rule: point 2 keeps the documented absence of order and that a position match proves nothing, and lists these failures as an open problem with no automatic rule reviewed sound.
